name: Prompt Forgery Guard
description: before_agent_finalize: a reply that hand-writes a script-owned Telegram prompt — a 💳 card header with a → verdict line, or an occasion/receipt question — is sent back for one more model pass. Built 2026-09-26, after the agent typed three fake '→ Dining — what was the occasion?' prompts for a charge the ledger had recorded as Groceries: no script sent them, the category was never Dining, and a forged prompt is indistinguishable from a real one. The outbound twin of callback-dispatch.
